MRT.note: The universal access decree is mentioned only as a change of ministry and regulator roles, with no rural programme or figures.
The document names no national digital strategy.
The document gives no budget line, fund or spending.

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers on 30 October 2024 adopted a draft decree setting the management and access rules of the KHADAMATI public services portal, meant to ease citizens' access to administrative services.
The Council of Ministers on 30 October 2024 adopted a draft decree on the KHADAMATI portal, which is to let citizens file grievances, reports and complaints through a secure digital infrastructure.
